wholePhysicalScope: The named lighthouse and its two adjacent dwelling footprints establish the extant layout. The 1962 federal survey depicts the same three masses and identifies the visible north gable.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the square lighthouse, octagonal lantern, cottage gables and kitchen wing.
limitations: The square tower and attached cottage are measured massings based on the native outline and three HABS plates. Select details are simplified. Colors derive from the published external descriptions.

The full tower height to finial is an approximate scaled reading of the two-part HABS elevation, while the Coast Guard lists the light at 73 feet above the lake. The keeper’s house follows the standing mapped outline.
The modeled scene includes the beacon exterior and the keeper’s residence. Nearby visitor buildings and the former boathouse are outside scope.
